projects.title: Realtime Proctoring Using IoT Devices
projects.description: Statistical validation model using explainable AI to distinguish suspicious activities during proctoring at higher education institutions. Framework trained with probabilistic prediction function based on Markov Chain for real-time instructor-free proctoring.
outcomes: Developed intelligent surveillance system for exam proctoring
Achieved high-performance real-time prediction using IoT devices
Published research with considerable outcomes for e-learning proctoring

projects.title: NAMAQ - Arabic Handwriting Recognition Using Deep Learning
projects.description: Recognition system for Arabic handwritten scripts using CNN for feature extraction. Addresses complexity of Arabic language characters and variations in handwriting styles with machine learning classifiers.
outcomes: Achieved 96.4% recognition rate for 29 Arabic character classes
Developed robust feature extraction using CNN
Tested with large-scale Arabic handwriting datasets

projects.title: Intelligent Student Information System
projects.description: Digital system providing administration and students easy access to necessary information and forms. Reduces paperwork, minimizes errors, and facilitates systematic information management with complete student statistics.
outcomes: Eliminated paper-based form processing
Automated student information collection and management
Provided real-time statistics to administration
Reduced processing time and resource wastage

projects.title: COVID-19 Advising Application for Apple Devices (iOS)
projects.description: Powerful NLP-based iOS application to advise COVID-19 patients. Helps users identify critical situations and make necessary decisions when infected. Focuses on security and safety advantages of iOS platform.
outcomes: Developed secure iOS healthcare application
Implemented NLP for patient symptom analysis
Provided real-time COVID-19 medical advice
Enhanced security compared to Android/web alternatives

projects.title: DSpace Publication Repository System in University Environment
projects.description: Survey-based study for deploying publication repository systems in Saudi Arabian government universities. Provides data on academic intentions to maintain university-level research information.
outcomes: Assessed academic publication repository needs
Provided deployment guidelines for universities
Facilitated research information management
Published framework for university repository systems

projects.title: Blockchain-Based Digitally Secured Model for Educational Sector
projects.description: Secure, fast, and transparent model for academic certificate verification in Saudi Arabia's education sector. Uses blockchain technology to prevent document fraud and facilitate digital transformation in academic document verification.
outcomes: Developed blockchain-based certificate verification system
Prevented academic document fraud and forgery
Enabled fast and transparent verification process
Supported Saudi Arabia's digital transformation goals

projects.title: Project Management System (PMS) at College of Computing and IT
projects.description: Application to manage complete datasets for quality assurance projects in academic domain. Blends DOI model with TAM Model to measure academics' intentions to use the Project Management System.
outcomes: Deployed PMS at College of Computing and IT, Shaqra University
Managed quality assurance project datasets
Positive relationship found between perceived usefulness and usage intentions
Improved academic information management efficiency

projects.title: Intelligent Alumni Management System for Universities
projects.description: Alumni information management system enabling communications between colleges and graduates. Provides platform for job opportunities, announcements, and professional networking. Focuses on security, usability, and accessibility.
outcomes: Facilitated university-alumni communication
Created job opportunity discovery platform
Collected graduate working experience data
Improved teaching process through graduate feedback

projects.title: COVIBOT - Intelligent WhatsApp Based Advising Bot for COVID-19
projects.description: WhatsApp messenger integrated bot using AI and NLP to advise COVID-19 patients about first aid and immediate treatment. Provides symptom-based medical attention guidance and nearest hospital information.
outcomes: Developed AI-powered COVID-19 advisory chatbot
Integrated with WhatsApp for wide accessibility
Provided symptom-based medical advice
Directed patients to nearest medical facilities

projects.title: Mubadarah System - Intelligent System for Proposals at University
projects.description: Interactive system for proposing and voting on ideas at university level. Creates transparent communication between decision-makers and stakeholders. 'Mubadarah' (meaning 'Idea' in Arabic) enables online proposal submission and democratic voting.
outcomes: Enabled transparent idea proposal mechanism
Implemented democratic voting system
Facilitated stakeholder-administration communication
Streamlined university decision-making process

projects.title: Medidrone - Drone Based Emergency Service System for Saudi Healthcare
projects.description: Emergency service system using drones to provide first aid at accident locations in Saudi Arabia. Addresses traffic delays in ambulance services through mobile app integration and drone deployment.
outcomes: Developed drone-based emergency response system
Reduced emergency response time in traffic conditions
Integrated mobile app for accident reporting
Provided rapid first aid delivery mechanism

projects.title: Course Add/Drop Management System
projects.description: Web-based platform that simplifies academic course registration and modification. Allows students to view available courses and submit add or drop requests online with ease. The system follows a structured multi-level approval process involving academic advisors, department heads, and registrars to ensure accuracy and compliance with university policies. Users receive real-time status updates and email notifications throughout the workflow. Once approved, the system generates a downloadable PDF record of the request.
outcomes: Simplified course registration and modification process for students
Implemented multi-level approval workflow for compliance and accuracy
Provided real-time status updates and email notifications
Generated downloadable PDF records of approved requests
Reduced paperwork and improved transparency in academic operations
Enhanced efficiency for students and academic administrators

projects.title: Student Absence Management System
projects.description: Web-based application that streamlines leave requests and approvals within an academic workflow. Enables students to register, submit absence/leave applications, and track real-time status through a three-level hierarchical approval pipeline involving Advisors, Heads of Department (HODs), and Vice Deans. The system provides role-based access, unified authentication for staff, and dashboard interfaces for each user category. Requests traverse sequential approval stages, capturing decision states and timestamps to ensure auditability. Its UI guides users through application submission, progress monitoring, and administrative review.
outcomes: Streamlined leave request and approval process for students
Implemented three-level hierarchical approval pipeline
Provided role-based access control for different user categories
Enabled real-time status tracking and monitoring
Captured comprehensive decision states and timestamps for auditability
Enhanced efficiency and transparency in academic absence management
Unified authentication system for staff members

projects.title: Field (Cooperative) Education Program
projects.description: Structured experiential learning initiative that bridges academic theory with real-world industry practice. Hosted as an interactive online handbook, this project outlines program goals, stakeholder responsibilities, procedures, assessment methods, and essential forms to support students, faculty, and host organizations. It aims to guide undergraduate trainees through every stage of their professional field training, ensuring clarity, compliance, and measurable outcomes. By integrating curriculum requirements with workplace expectations, this platform enhances student preparedness and strengthens university-industry collaboration for computing and IT disciplines.
outcomes: Created comprehensive interactive online handbook for field education program
Documented program goals, stakeholder responsibilities, and procedures
Established clear assessment methods and compliance frameworks
Provided essential forms and resources for students, faculty, and host organizations
Enhanced student preparedness through structured guidance
Strengthened university-industry collaboration
Integrated curriculum requirements with workplace expectations
Supported all stages of professional field training

projects.title: Field Training Permission System
projects.description: Web platform that simplifies how students register and apply for cooperative/field training. It allows secure login and registration, captures essential student details, and streamlines permission requests for field training in partnership with industry organizations. This tool supports academic units in managing training records and helps students connect with practical work opportunities, enhancing their readiness for future careers.
outcomes: Simplified student registration and field training application process
Implemented secure login and authentication mechanisms
Captured and managed essential student details efficiently
Streamlined permission requests for field training partnerships
Enabled academic units to manage training records effectively
Facilitated student-industry organization connections
Enhanced student career readiness through practical opportunities
Improved accessibility to cooperative training programs
